content:
Sam: FYI VegaHealth QBR scheduled for next Wednesday. Their onboarding progress shows a few gaps (SSO not fully validated, docs missing advanced examples). Also noticed a sudden token surge from test envs + prod: roughly 2.9x baseline in 48h. Need a crisp cost slide + mitigation plan.

billing-bot: SPEND_ALERT account=VegaHealth multiplier=2.9 window=48h top_paths=[/embeddings/encode,/chat/completions] link=https://console.redwood.example/accounts/vegahealth/spend

Rina: I can take the cost slide. Will produce a 30/60/90 day projection with scenario bounds. Need to know if we should include committed credits impact and possible top-up ask.

Sam: Yes include committed credits math + an ask line (e.g., temporary credit top-up or a short-term rate-limit). Also show cost per 1k tokens for their main flows.

Ethan: Quick read of their traffic: lots of tiny embedding requests (>95% <=64 tokens). We should recommend mini-batching (combine <=8 vectors) and client-side dedupe for similar vectors. That alone could cut embedding ops ~40%.

Noor: On model-side ops: suggest q4 quantization profile for their embedding model (8-bit dynamic) and a lightweight caching layer for repeated vectors. I'll draft the config and the perf delta.

Caleb: For renewal risk I'm seeing low recent engagement from the PMs and the last CSAT was lukewarm. I'll prepare a one-slide health summary (score + top 3 blockers + suggested remediation). Need the latest NPS quote if available.

Rina: Timeline: I'll drop draft numbers tomorrow AM. Planning conservative/expected/optimistic scenarios. Example row I will include in CSV: 
```
date,conservative,expected,optimistic
2026-05-01,11500,33500,47000
```
I'll also attach per-route breakdown (embeddings/chat/embeddings-batch).

billing-bot: NOTE: billing_threshold 70% reached for committed credits. Action recommended: CS outreach + options: temp top-up / throttle non-critical routes.

Noor: Quick config snippet for client batching to share with their engs:
```
# client-side vector bundling (pseudo)
batcher = []
for v in vectors:
  batcher.append(v)
  if len(batcher) >= 8 or timeout:
    send(batch=copy(batcher))
    batcher.clear()
```
This plus server-side dedupe should help.

Ethan: I'm happy to run a short perf test against a shadow endpoint—compare fp16 vs 8-bit quant. Expect compute cost down ~12-18% and latency similar. Will post numbers in the thread.

Sam: Great. Also include a rollback plan: if batching or quant causes any degradation, we roll back to current model and enable short-lived burst credits while we triage. Keep rollback steps explicit.

Caleb: Health score pulled = 58. Recent verbatim feedback: "Advanced embeddings examples are missing; team wasted time debugging vector batching." Adding that quote to the renewal slide.

Rina: Putting the ask on the slide: 30-day temporary credit top-up of $25k OR apply a soft throttle to non-prod routes until we complete optimizations. Will include exact phrasing for legal/billing.

Sam: Thanks all. Please post your artifacts (CSV, config snippets, perf CSVs) into this thread. We aim to finalize the QBR deck by Friday EOD. Ping me for blockers.

Ethan: Uploaded perf delta table to Drive and will paste summary here when ready.

Rina: Drafts incoming.

Sam: Closing loop for now.
